title: Shimmering Scribble-Squid
statement: Surrounded by swaying amber kelp and tidy shelves of sorted sea glass, this curious little cephalopod composes swirling, bioluminescent ink-notes that hang like constellations in the quiet current before dissolving into mist. Whenever a visitor pauses outside its tank, it blinks thoughtfully, flashes a polite ripple of pastel dots, and returns to rearranging its pebble library.
